title: Kagurabachi to Expand World Tour With More Early Anime Premieres
content: There is probably no anime adaptation more hyped than Kagurabachi in the past few years, as fans have been wishing to see this shonen manga come to life even before its first chapter hit shelves more than three years ago.
author: ComicBook

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fifth Ending Featuring "Sakura addiction" by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fifth ending, featuring the song “Sakura addiction” by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida. The song was used in Episodes 52-62, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Reveals Additional Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga revealed additional staff, theme songs, the main visual (pictured), and promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rudy Learns of a Tragic Future in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 12 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 12 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 13 premiere. The episode previously released the “Turning Point 4” episode, introducing a future Rudeus and setting up a dark atmosphere for the rest of the season.
author: Anime Corner

title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Anime's New Video Unveils More Staff, Theme Songs, October 5 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Nazuna Miki and artist Tsukasa Araki 's So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ( Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ) manga presented on Wednesday the anime's main promotional video, main visual, additional staff members, theme songs, and October 5 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Redoing My Youth In Another World -The God Of Death Is My Fanboy- BL Manga Gets 'Motion Comic' on TV
content: Renta! announced on Wednesday that Taiyō no Taiyō MANGA SHOKUNIN STUDIO and Hare Takizawa's Redoing My Youth In Another World -The God Of Death Is My Fanboy- ( Seishun no Yarinaoshi wa Isekai de -Shinigami wa Ore no Koto ga Sukisugiru- ) vertical boys-love manga is receiving an "AniComi" or "motion comic" adaptation…
author: ANN

title: Fate/EXTRA Record Game Streams Character Video for Saber
content: Aniplex started streaming the first character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Wednesday. The video features the character Saber, as voiced by Sakura Tange .
author: ANN

title: From The Apothecary Diaries to Jurassic Shadows: Norihiro Naganuma's Next Creative Challenge
content: What happens when the director behind Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ( The Apothecary Diaries ) and Mahoutsukai no Yome ( The Ancient Magus' Bride ) trades court intrigue and fantasy for dinosaurs, ninjas, and superpowered makeup?
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shiden Kanzaki Launches Black Bullet Reboot Project, New Original Work
content: Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint announced on Wednesday that Shiden Kanzaki 's Black Bullet light novel series will have a reboot with new content, as well as a completely new story.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Anime World Tour Part 2 Heads to Africa and Australia With Episode 1 Preview
content: KAGURABACHI anime has revealed details for Part 2 of its ongoing Anime World Tour, with the first 20 minutes of Episode 1 set to screen at upcoming conventions in Johannesburg and Melbourne. The next stops will take place at Comic Con Africa in Johannesburg and PAX Aus in Melbourne.
author: Anime Corner
